name: sentinel
description: Sentinel: local-first memory and consistency with a shared CLI and VS Code brand system.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/vault/tsconfig.json packages/llm/tsconfig.json packages/analyzer/tsconfig.json packages/guardian/tsconfig.json packages/webview/tsconfig.json packages/cli/tsconfig.json packages/extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package
